classification: Failed bounded production-gameplay verification on the integrated source; late briefing evidence does not convert the failed readiness assertion into a pass.

test.title: real motocross player entry, eight-rider gate, riding, cameras, pause and venue switch

evidence.reviewMethod: Read-only inspection of saved trace records, network responses, screencast images, final DOM snapshot, execution log and unchanged test source. No browser or test rerun.

timeline.clock: Playwright trace monotonic milliseconds; these are trace timestamps, not simulation time.

events.event: Browser-level #raceBriefing visibility expectation starts with timeout 300000 ms.
Expectation log records toBeVisible with timeout 300000 ms.
Expectation log records waiting for locator('#raceBriefing').
Screencast still shows the loader: SETTING UP CAMERAS, 90%.
Screencast shows the loader: SETTING UP THE COCKPIT, 90%.
Last screencast before the failed call returns still shows the loader: WARMING UP TYRES, 94%.
Visibility expectation returns timedOut: true, matches: false, received element(s) not found.
DOM snapshot contains an open modal with #raceBriefing, Motocross race briefing and GO TO THE GATE. The loading container is hidden.
Test-level expectation records the failed visibility assertion.

timeline.interpretation: The final DOM is later evidence than the failed expectation. The last preceding screencast still shows loading. These observations support a late readiness transition, but do not establish the exact instant the briefing became available or why the readiness deadline was missed.

finalDom.retainedHiddenLoaderText: Waiting for completed cockpit GPU work…
finalDom.limitation: A retained hidden progress message does not identify the bottleneck. The DOM snapshot does not establish a passed readiness assertion, initialized-grid diagnostics, or subsequent gameplay.

capturedErrorsAndNetwork.scope: Available saved trace and execution log only; the test stopped before its final collected-error assertion.
capturedErrorsAndNetwork.intermediatePollErrors: Earlier apx01-versus-mx450 and showroom-frame-count expectation records are intermediate expect.poll attempts. Those polls subsequently progressed and are not separate terminal test failures.
capturedErrorsAndNetwork.limitation: Absence of a captured error is not proof that every subsystem was healthy, nor a diagnosis of the delay.

resourceObservation.source: Root-agent observation during the delayed run, separate from the Playwright trace.
resourceObservation.interpretation: Near-limit memory usage is relevant context, but the available evidence does not prove that memory pressure caused this timeout.

unexecutedLaterAssertions: Outdoor initialized-grid diagnostics, including complete preparation and all eight selected-machine entrant records.
GO TO THE GATE action and transition into driving.
Player body controls and real course traversal.
Qualifying flight, touchdown and rendered riding.
Arena Nord Supercross / MX250 selection, preparation and gameplay journey.

conclusion.supportedFinding: The integrated build missed the unchanged bounded outdoor readiness assertion; a post-timeout snapshot then showed the briefing.
conclusion.notEstablished: The trace does not isolate a source regression, resource contention, GPU preparation delay, or scheduling delay as the cause.
conclusion.reportingBoundary: Preserve the failed integrated result. Attribute the earlier successful two-venue gameplay journey to its exact 8e45d33 source; do not claim a passed f73fea5 gameplay journey.
